question: Should experimental schema-version 1 redefine a non-empty `CLAW.md` body from descriptive text to executable `SOUL.md` prompt content, or should portable prompt content use a new versioned or explicit field?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a documented package interpretation, and choosing whether existing experimental packages should be reinterpreted is a product and compatibility contract decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Preserve v1 semantics and version the prompt contract
options.body: Keep schema-v1 bodies descriptive and introduce an approved explicit or newer-version prompt representation with migration and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Adopt the new v1 interpretation
options.body: Approve body materialization for existing experimental packages and require clear upgrade communication plus add, update, and export proof for affected packages.

recommendation.title: Preserve v1 semantics and version the prompt contract
recommendation.body: Keep schema-v1 bodies descriptive and introduce an approved explicit or newer-version prompt representation with migration and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the proposed portable-contract interpretation and can incorporate the maintainer-selected direction, although final product approval should come from the responsible Claws owner.
